MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful next addition because its larger display adds video calling and convenient Alexa control alongside my Fire TV devices.",
    "The Smart Plug fits my interest in practical connected-home additions: automating a lamp gives me a new capability rather than repeating something I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick offers little benefit when I already own a 4K Stick, and another 4K Stick duplicates it without a clear need for an additional device.",
    "The voice-only Echo devices do not serve a specific need for me right now, while the Show 5 is less appealing than the larger Show 8 display.",
    "The SSD assumes a computer storage upgrade need that my recent purchases do not show."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend more Fire TV devices, even though owning one reduces my immediate need for another.",
    "My interest in connected-home devices seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any Alexa device, regardless of what it would add to my setup."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about whether a device adds a useful capability to what I already own, such as video calling or lamp automation.",
    "My preference for the Show 8 over smaller or voice-only devices reflects a specific use for a larger display, rather than a general desire for more Alexa access."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connected-home interest but miss the distinction between useful additions and devices that duplicate capabilities I already have."
}
